name: VQAv2
intro: VQAv2 是 Gemma 3 报告中使用的视觉问答 benchmark，用于评估模型基于图像回答自然语言问题的能力。
build_method: 互补图像众包, 同问题不同答案平衡, 每题10个人类答案
build_method_en: Crowdsourced complementary images, same-question different-answer balancing, ten human answers per item
intro_en: VQAv2 is a visual question answering benchmark used by the Gemma 3 report to evaluate image-grounded natural-language QA.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with VQA v2.0 arXiv:1612.00837 and official visualqa.org complementary-pairs documentation. VQA v2 balances VQA by collecting a similar complementary image for each reusable question such that the answer changes, then gathers ten human answers per image-question pair. The official train, validation, and test sets contain 443,757, 214,354, and 447,793 questions; evaluation uses standard VQA soft accuracy and complementary-pair diagnostics.
